definition.def: Manual work is work in which you use your hands or your physical strength rather than your mind.
examples: They have no reservations about taking factory or manual jobs.

definition.def: Manual is used to talk about movements which are made by someone's hands. [formal]
examples: ...toys designed to help develop manual dexterity.

definition.def: Manual means operated by hand, rather than by electricity or a motor.
examples: There is a manual pump to get rid of the water.

definition.def: A manual is a book which tells you how to do something or how a piece of machinery works.
